items.title: Steelers rule out Joey Porter Jr.; Jalen Ramsey hopes to play vs. Browns
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr. will miss his fourth straight game when Pittsburgh visits the Cleveland Browns on Thursday night.
items.body:
Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr. will miss his fourth straight game when Pittsburgh visits the Cleveland Browns on Thursday night.
Porter was limited in practice Wednesday after coach Mike McCarthy expressed hope earlier this week that he would make his season debut.
Porter, 26, has been slowly recovering from a back injury and his conditioning has been improving.
Fellow Pittsburgh cornerback Jalen Ramsey (wrist) is listed as questionable but hopes to play. He says he broke his right wrist early in Sunday's 30-27 victory over the Cincinnati Bengals.
"I'm going to try to (play), but I've got to be able to protect it," Ramsey, an eight-time Pro Bowl selection, told reporters. "Obviously, it's a real injury. A broken wrist. I can't do anything about it."
Running back Rico Dowdle (toe) will miss his second consecutive game and cornerback Brandin Echols (concussion) is questionable.
Jaylen Warren will again be the primary running back for the Steelers. He had 176 scrimmage yards (127 rushing, 49 receiving) against Cincinnati.
"What a tough guy," quarterback Aaron Rodgers said of Warren. "I've always had respect for him, played against him and then being his teammate now for a little more than a season. He is one of the toughest guys I've ever played with."
For Cleveland, receiver Tylan Wallace (knee), center Elgton Jenkins (concussion) and guard Teven Jenkins (back) were ruled out. Teven Jenkins will miss his fourth straight game.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Preços do açúcar bruto caem com vencimento do contrato de outubro na ICE
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os futuros do açúcar bruto na ICE caíram nesta quarta-feira, com o vencimento do contrato de outubro servindo de foco no curto prazo, enquanto os preços do café arábica registraram uma leve alta.
items.body:
Os futuros do açúcar bruto na ICE caíram nesta quarta-feira, com o vencimento do contrato de outubro servindo de foco no curto prazo, enquanto os preços do café arábica registraram uma leve alta.
AÇÚCAR * O contrato de açúcar bruto fechou em queda de 0,19 centavo, ou 1,1%, a 17,63 centavos por libra-peso.
* Operadores afirmaram que a oferta permaneceu abundante, com o contrato de outubro fechando com um desconto de 1,02 centavos em relação ao de março em seu último dia de negociação.
* O vencimento registrou entregas de 1,45 milhão de toneladas métricas, tendo a brasileira BTG Pactual Commodities como principal fornecedora e a asiática Wilmar como única receptora do açúcar, segundo os corretores.
* As entregas ficaram em linha com as expectativas do mercado de um volume ligeiramente abaixo das 1,52 milhão de toneladas entregues no contrato de outubro de 2025.
* O açúcar branco recuou 0,6%, para US$ 506,30 por tonelada.
* Não houve participantes em uma licitação do Paquistão para vender e exportar 107.739 toneladas de açúcar branco, segundo os corretores .
* A Índia registrou sua menor precipitação de monção em mais de uma década durante a temporada de junho a setembro, já que o fenômeno climático El Niño reduziu a precipitação.
CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou em alta de 1,25 centavos, ou 0,4%, a US$2,907 por libra.
* Os corretores afirmaram que o mercado foi impulsionado, em parte, por possíveis problemas de qualidade na safra brasileira de 2026, devido à maior umidade associada ao atual El Niño.
* A Cooxupé, maior cooperativa cafeeira do Brasil e principal exportadora brasileira de café, informou em um comunicado aos seus produtores associados na terça-feira que rejeitará grãos com problemas de qualidade causados pelo excesso de umidade.
* Os corretores afirmaram que a alta nos preços também foi impulsionada, em parte, por questões técnicas, com o mercado apresentando sobrevenda após uma queda acentuada em relação aos picos recentes registrados no final de agosto.
* O café robusta subiu 1%, para US$ 3.445 a tonelada.
(Reportagem de Nigel Hunt e Marcelo Teixeira)

items.title: Brazil's Nubank says it is not pursuing deal with Monzo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazilian digital lender Nubank said on Wednesday it is not pursuing a transaction with Monzo, after media reports had said Nubank was in early-stage talks to acquire the British digital bank.
items.body:
Brazilian digital lender Nubank said on Wednesday it is not pursuing a transaction with Monzo, after [USN:L1N45I02A TEXT:"media reports"] had said Nubank was in early-stage talks to acquire the British digital bank.
In a securities filing, Nubank said it regularly evaluates opportunities that could support growth and long-term goals, including investments and acquisitions
Nubank, which is listed as Nu Holdings (NU.N) , said its capital allocation framework is unchanged
Nubank said it is focused on its strategic priorities: "deepening its position in Brazil, scaling its businesses in Mexico and Colombia, and building its presence in the United States and around the world through Nu Global"
Shares in Nu Holdings [USN:L6N45M1BJ TEXT:"were up"] nearly 7% in trading in New York, after falling earlier this week on the media reports

O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta quarta-feira que discutiu a libertação de presos políticos com o presidente chinês, Xi Jinping, quando os dois líderes se encontraram na semana passada.
“Conversei com o presidente Xi. Sim, conversei. Conversamos, e acho que tivemos algumas discussões muito, muito importantes. Espero que tenham sido discussões frutíferas”, disse Trump aos repórteres.

items.title: Más de 270 sacerdotes de Massachusetts abusaron de menores durante décadas, según investigación
items.author: Nate Raymond
items.creator: Nate Raymond
items.summary: Más de 270 clérigos católicos abusaron sexualmente de casi 1.000 niños en tres diócesis de Massachusetts durante de varias décadas, según un informe de investigación publicado el miércoles por la fiscal general del estado.
items.body:
Más de 270 clérigos católicos abusaron sexualmente de casi 1.000 niños en tres diócesis de Massachusetts durante de varias décadas, según un informe de investigación publicado el miércoles por la fiscal general del estado.
El informe ofrece lo que la fiscal general de Massachusetts, Andrea Joy Campbell, ha calificado como el primer recuento público completo de los abusos y las deficiencias institucionales que permitieron que estos se extendieran durante más de medio siglo en las diócesis católicas de Fall River, Springfield y Worcester.
La mayor parte de los abusos detallados en el informe tuvieron lugar antes de 2002, año en que el escándalo de los abusos sexuales por parte del clero saltó a la palestra internacional a raíz de un reportaje del Boston Globe, galardonado con el Premio Pulitzer, sobre cómo los responsables de la Arquidiócesis católica romana de Boston encubrían sistemáticamente los abusos sexuales cometidos por sacerdotes.
La investigación de la fiscalía general del estado documentó años de problemas similares en las tres diócesis de otras zonas de Massachusetts, las cuales Campbell dijo que sabían que los niños estaban siendo abusados por sacerdotes.
"Con demasiada frecuencia protegieron la reputación de la Iglesia en lugar de proteger a los niños", dijo Campbell. "Detrás de cada una de esas cifras hay un niño cuya seguridad fue vulnerada, una familia que quedó marcada para siempre y un superviviente que ha cargado con el trauma de ese abuso durante años y, en muchos casos, décadas", dijo Campbell a los periodistas.
La Diócesis de Worcester, en un comunicado, dijo que estudiaría el informe "para identificar cualquier otra mejora que se pueda realizar para atender a las víctimas de abusos cometidos en el pasado y para seguir reforzando los esfuerzos destinados a garantizar la seguridad de los niños".
El obispo de Fall River, Edgar da Cunha, pidió perdón a los supervivientes de abusos sexuales infantiles y dijo que estaba "lleno de dolor ante el relato histórico de los incidentes y prácticas que reflejan los trágicos fallos a la hora de proteger a nuestros más vulnerables".
La investigación periodística del Boston Globe de 2002, que más tarde se plasmó en la película de 2015 "Spotlight", desencadenó una ola mundial de investigaciones que revelaron patrones similares en diócesis de todo el mundo e impulsó a la Asamblea Legislativa de Massachusetts a aprobar una serie de reformas.
En 2019, la entonces fiscal general Maura Healey, ahora gobernadora de Massachusetts, puso en marcha una investigación penal sobre las diócesis católicas romanas de Fall River, Springfield y Worcester para determinar si estas o sus líderes tenían responsabilidad alguna en relación con la supervisión del clero que abusó de menores.
Campbell, quien dijo haber sido ella misma víctima de abusos infantiles a manos de un familiar, señaló que su oficina remitió tres casos a los fiscales del distrito locales durante la investigación, lo que dio lugar a la formulación de cargos en un caso en Worcester.
Su oficina no llevó a cabo ningún proceso judicial debido a que algunas conductas no eran ilegales en el momento en que ocurrieron o porque habían prescrito, explicó.
Campbell señaló que el informe ponía de manifiesto la necesidad de que las diócesis pongan en marcha reformas y de que se aprueben nuevas leyes estatales en apoyo de los supervivientes de abusos, incluida la eliminación de la prescripción para las demandas civiles relacionadas con abusos sexuales en la infancia.

NEW YORK, Sept 30 : US stocks gyrated on Wednesday, caught in the tug-of-war of mixed signals.
Cooler-than-expected inflation data tempered rate hike expectations from the Federal Reserve, while upbeat GDP, consumer spending and private payrolls data underscored US economic resilience. Even so, rising crude prices kept inflation jitters alive, while long-dated US Treasury yields moved higher for the seventh straight day.
The S&P 500 and the Dow lost ground on the week, while the Nasdaq advanced. For the quarter, the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq posted gains, but the Dow ended the July-September period lower.
I will go into more detail on today's market moves below. If you have more time to read, here are a few articles I recommend to help you make sense of what happened in markets today.

1. Cool inflation data diminishes the likelihood of an October rate hike from the Federal Reserve
2. Second-quarter US GDP revised higher amid robust consumer spending
3. The Federal Trade Commission is conducting an industry-wide probe to determine potential dangers posed by AI
4. Russia unleashed widely anticipated airstrikes against Ukraine's energy grid as winter looms
5. The Securities and Exchange Commission proposes new regulations aimed at giving accredited investors more access to private assets
Today's Key Market Moves
• STOCKS: Wall Street was mixed, with tech boosting the Nasdaq into positive territory, while European stocks logged their first monthly loss in six, bogged down by oil prices, bond yields
• SECTORS/SHARES: Tech, communication services and software/services were clear outperformers; megacaps, led by Alphabet and Apple, provided upside muscle
• FX: The dollar softened against a basket of world currencies as cool inflation data reduced rate hike bets
• BONDS: US Treasury yields notched a seventh straight day of gains to reach multi-year highs
• COMMODITIES/METALS: Crude prices settled higher amid stalled US-Iran talks; Gold reversed earlier gains as higher energy prices eclipsed cool inflation data
Today's Talking Points
* Markets turn the page on the month, quarter
Investors have closed the book on a tumultuous month and quarter, and markets have emerged intact.
This, despite a global bond rout driven by spiking energy costs, mounting debt, inflation jitters, existential fears of an AI-driven apocalypse, looming midterm elections, lack of progress in negotiations aimed toward ending the Iran war, and the simple fact that September is traditionally the worst month for stocks.
* Iran says it received Washington's response to its latest proposal as US troops withdraw from Iraq
While President Trump said he rejected Tehran's latest peace proposal, Iran's foreign minister, Abbas Araqchi, said he had not received a formal rejection, and an Iranian government spokesperson said Araqchi had conveyed a response to Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days after the US lifts its blockade.
Meanwhile, Iran's allies were celebrating the departure of the last American forces from neighboring Iraq, calling the pullout a victory for its "axis of resistance."
* Saudi Arabia denies Israeli request to allow its planes to pick up Israeli passengers
Saudi Arabia turned down the request to send Israeli military aircraft to retrieve Israeli citizens after a flydubai flight made an emergency landing in the kingdom, according to two security sources.
The passengers were set to resume their journey to Dubai, the airline said, after the co-pilot stabbed the pilot and tried to crash the plane. But passengers restrained the attacker while other pilots landed the plane, said Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
What could move markets tomorrow?
• Developments in the Middle East
• Energy market moves
• US benchmark Treasury yields
• US Federal Reserve speakers: Richmond Fed President Thomas Barkin, Fed Governor Christopher Waller, Vice Chair Philip Jefferson, Vice Chair Michelle Bowman, NY Fed President John Williams, Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan
• US Challenger layoffs (September)
• US Weekly jobless claims
• US ISM PMI (September)
• EU PMI (September)
• UK PMI (September)

items.title: CScale raises $145 million for AI networking, with backing from Nvidia and Intel
items.author: Stephen Nellis
items.creator: Stephen Nellis
items.summary: CScale, a Silicon Valley startup developing a way to connect AI chips with fiber-optic cables instead of fiber, said on Wednesday it has raised $145 million in venture capital, with backing from Nvidia and Intel .
items.body:
CScale, a Silicon Valley startup developing a way to connect AI chips with fiber-optic cables instead of fiber, said on Wednesday it has raised $145 million in venture capital, with backing from Nvidia (NVDA.O) and Intel (INTC.O) .
The company, which formerly went by the name CSpeed and has given few details about its technology, is being led by CEO Martin Lund, who left his post [USN:L6N3Z51BH TEXT:"overseeing chip and hardware systems"] for networking giant Cisco Systems (CSCO.O) earlier this year.
With the funding, CScale is joining a scramble in Silicon Valley to replace the copper cables that wire together the chips inside AI data center servers with optical cables.
Copper cables are fast and reliable, but have limited reach. Those reach limits have forced chip designers such as Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) to pack their processors tightly together inside servers, which in turn requires elaborate liquid cooling systems because of the heat generated by the chips.
[USN:L4N3X81HQ TEXT:"Public companies"] and [USN:L6N4511GY TEXT:"startups"] alike are pouring billions of dollars into replacing those connections with optical connections that use flashes of laser light instead of electrons to carry data. But those lasers are prone to frequent failures, and so many of the firms chasing technology keep the laser separate from the chip so that it can be replaced.
In an interview, Lund declined to give specifics of CScale's technology except to say that the company will integrate lasers onto the chips in a way that does not interrupt the flow of data when the lasers fail.
"We're not using any exotic technologies," Lund said. "We're using proven technologies, integrating them together in a novel way, but preserving the same trusted fiber technology that has been out there and shipping in the industry for many, many years now."
Lund said CScale, which has raised $188 million to date, plans to ship its chips by 2028.
Leading the financing round were Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners and Premji Invest. Existing investors Sutter Hill Ventures and Maverick Silicon also took part in the funding announced on Wednesday.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: LIV Golf player Phil Mickelson checked himself into an addiction treatment center due to "family trauma and addiction", TMZ reported on Wednesday.
items.body:
LIV Golf player Phil Mickelson checked himself into an addiction treatment center due to "family trauma and addiction", TMZ reported on Wednesday .

items.title: Trading Day: Shrugging off a volatile September, markets shuffle into Q4
items.author: Stephen Culp
items.creator: Stephen Culp
items.summary: US stocks gyrated on Wednesday, caught in the tug-of-war of mixed signals.
items.body:
US stocks gyrated on Wednesday, caught in the tug-of-war of mixed signals.
Cooler-than-expected inflation data tempered rate hike expectations from the Federal Reserve, while upbeat GDP, consumer spending and private payrolls data underscored US economic resilience. Even so, rising crude prices kept inflation jitters alive, while long-dated US Treasury yields moved higher for the seventh straight day.
The S&P 500 and the Dow lost ground on the week, while the Nasdaq advanced. For the quarter, the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq posted gains, but the Dow ended the July-September period lower.
I will go into more detail on today's market moves below. If you have more time to read, here are a few articles I recommend to help you make sense of what happened in markets today.
[USN:SPN45A013 TEXT:"Cool inflation data diminishes the likelihood of an October rate hike from the Federal Reserve"]
[USN:L1N45L0XU TEXT:"Second-quarter US GDP revised higher amid robust consumer spending"]
[USN:L4N45M17I TEXT:"The Federal Trade Commission is conducting an industry-wide probe to determine potential dangers posed by AI"]
[USN:P8N44K00B TEXT:"Russia unleashed widely anticipated airstrikes against Ukraine's energy grid as winter looms"]
[USN:L6N45K0XZ TEXT:"The Securities and Exchange Commission proposes new regulations aimed at giving accredited investors more access to private assets"]
Today's Key Market Moves
STOCKS: [USN:L4N45M0LR TEXT:"Wall Street"] was mixed, with tech boosting the Nasdaq into positive territory, while [USN:L6N45M0EW TEXT:"European stocks"] logged their first monthly loss in six, bogged down by oil prices, bond yields
SECTORS/SHARES: Tech, communication services and software/services were clear outperformers; megacaps, led by Alphabet and Apple, provided upside muscle
FX: [USN:L1N45M00D TEXT:"The dollar"] softened against a basket of world currencies as cool inflation data reduced rate hike bets
BONDS: US Treasury yields notched a seventh straight day of gains to reach multi-year highs
COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L4N45M00Q TEXT:"Crude prices"] settled higher amid stalled US-Iran talks; [USN:L4N45M010 TEXT:"Gold"] reversed earlier gains as higher energy prices eclipsed cool inflation data
Today's Talking Points
* Markets turn the page on the month, quarter
Investors have closed the book on a [USN:L8N45G0H5 TEXT:"tumultuous month and quarter"], and markets have emerged intact.
This, despite a global bond rout driven by spiking energy costs, mounting debt, inflation jitters, existential fears of an AI-driven apocalypse, looming midterm elections, lack of progress in negotiations aimed toward ending the Iran war, and the simple fact that September is traditionally the worst month for stocks.
* Iran says it received Washington's response to its latest proposal as US troops withdraw from Iraq
While President Trump said he rejected [USN:L6N45M02H TEXT:"Tehran's latest peace proposal"], Iran's foreign minister, Abbas Araqchi, said he had not received a formal rejection, and an Iranian government spokesperson said Araqchi had conveyed a response to Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days after the US lifts its blockade.
Meanwhile, Iran's allies were celebrating the departure of the last American forces from neighboring Iraq, calling the pullout a victory for its "axis of resistance."
* Saudi Arabia denies Israeli request to allow its planes to pick up Israeli passengers
[USN:L8N45M1LP TEXT:"Saudi Arabia turned down the request"] to send Israeli military aircraft to retrieve Israeli citizens after a flydubai flight made an emergency landing in the kingdom, according to two security sources.
The passengers were set to resume their journey to Dubai, the airline said, after the co-pilot stabbed the pilot and tried to crash the plane. But passengers restrained the attacker while other pilots landed the plane, said Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

items.title: Etihad to seek legal advice after Premier League’s Man City findings
items.author: Lori Ewing
items.creator: Lori Ewing
items.summary: Abu Dhabi-based airline Etihad Airways said on Wednesday it was seeking legal advice on its options after criticising the Premier League’s handling of an independent commission's findings against Manchester City.
items.body:
Abu Dhabi-based airline Etihad Airways said on Wednesday it was seeking legal advice on its options after criticising the Premier League’s handling of an independent commission's [USN:L6N45L10S TEXT:"findings against"] Manchester City.
The Premier League said on Tuesday that City had used "sham" commercial contracts as part of schemes to inflate revenue and understate costs by more than £900 million ($1.2 billion) over nearly a decade.
Etihad, City's principal sponsor since 2009, said it "categorically rejects any finding, conclusion or implication" that it was involved in improper commercial arrangements.
In a statement, the airline said the league never contacted or consulted it during the commission process and gave it no opportunity to provide information or challenge material that may have reflected adversely on the company.
"Etihad is deeply concerned by the way this matter has been communicated publicly," the statement said. "The lack of clarity and transparency, together with the selective disclosure of information, has created damaging implications for Etihad despite the airline not being named in the published decision."
City have denied any wrongdoing and said they intend to appeal.
A Premier League spokesperson said on Wednesday they would not be commenting on the Etihad statement.
Etihad added that the Premier League's public communication of the findings, following what it described as selective leaks and reporting, had harmed its reputation.
While reaffirming its support for Manchester City and its longstanding partnership with the club, the airline said it was seeking legal advice on the options available to protect its interests.
"We stand with the club, its supporters and our wider Etihad community as Manchester City challenges the commission's conclusions through the processes available to it," the statement said.

items.title: マイクロン、売上高予想が市場予想上回る　ＡＩ需要追い風
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Anhata Rooprai

[３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Anhata Rooprai

[３０日 ロイター] - 半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーが３０日発表した２０２７会計年度の第１・四半期（９─１２月）売上高見通しは、市場予想を上回った。人工知能（ＡＩ）を追い風とするメモリー半導体の好況が業績拡大を後押しし続けるとの見方を示した。

株価は時間外取引で１％超上昇した。年初来で株価は３倍以上に上昇している。

第１・四半期の売上高は６１５億ドル（プラスマイナス１５億ドル）を見込む。ＬＳＥＧが集計したアナリスト予想の平均５７０億２０００万ドルを上回った。調整後１株当たり利益は３８．１５ドル（プラスマイナス１ドル）を予想。市場予想の３５．４０ドルを上回った。

テクナリシス・リサーチのチーフアナリスト、ボブ・オドネル氏は「マイクロンの決算と見通しは完全に予想を圧倒する内容で、ＡＩインフラ投資の持続性に懐疑的な向きにとどめを刺すはずだ」と述べた。

同時に発表した２０２６会計年度の第４・四半期（２６年６―８月期）の売上高は前年同期比で４倍超の５４２億３０００万ドルとなり、市場予想の５１０億７０００万ドルを上回った。調整後１株当たり利益は３３．４２ドルで、予想の３１．６１ドルを上回った。

生成ＡＩブームにより、高帯域幅メモリー（ＨＢＭ）はデータセンターにとって不可欠な存在となっている。エヌビディアの主要サプライヤーであるマイクロンをはじめ、関連企業が恩恵を受けている。

米国に本拠を置く唯一の主要ＨＢＭメーカーであるマイクロンは、受注が生産能力を大幅に上回っている。ＡＩ向けメモリー需要の急拡大は、従来型半導体の供給逼迫（ひっぱく）を招き、半導体市場全体で価格を押し上げている。

需要増に対応するため、マイクロンは積極的な増産に動いており、２０３５年までの米国内投資計画を２５００億ドル超に引き上げた。アマゾン・ドット・コムやグーグルの親会社である米アルファベットなど米テクノロジー大手は、２０２６年にＡＩインフラに７３００億ドル超を投じる見通し。

items.title: Arizona court says judge wrongly allowed AI-generated victim video
items.author: Mike Scarcella
items.creator: Mike Scarcella
items.summary: An Arizona appeals court on Wednesday ordered a new sentencing hearing for a man convicted of a fatal road-rage shooting, finding that a judge improperly relied on an AI-generated video depicting the victim speaking about forgiveness and addressing the defendant directly.
items.body:
An Arizona appeals court on Wednesday ordered a new sentencing hearing for a man convicted of a fatal road-rage shooting, finding that a judge improperly relied on an AI-generated video depicting the victim speaking about forgiveness and addressing the defendant directly.
The order by a three-judge panel of the Arizona Court of Appeals vacates a 10.5-year prison term for the alleged shooter, Gabriel Horcasitas, and returns the case to the lower court to redetermine his sentence.
The appeals court upheld the defendant’s manslaughter conviction but said the AI-generated video should not have been allowed during sentencing.
“While the record does not reflect precisely how the AI video factored into the sentencing calculus, there is no question it played a role,” wrote Judge D. Steven Williams, joined by Judge Anni Hill Foster and Vice Chief Judge David Weinzweig.
The court said the trial judge’s “consideration of the AI video so prejudiced Horcasitas as to render the sentencing procedure fundamentally unfair.”
The Arizona attorney general’s office declined to comment. A public defender representing Horcasitas also declined to comment.
The presentation of the video last year at the sentencing hearing appeared to be one of the first such instances in a US courtroom. State and federal courts across the country are weighing guidelines and rules for the use of AI technology, including evidentiary matters.
Horcasitas argued the video was not reliable and should not have been allowed. Prosecutors defended the inclusion of the video.
Crime victims and their family members and friends generally are allowed to address a court at the time of a defendant’s sentencing.
The video was made by the victim’s family and depicted an AI-generated avatar of Christopher Pelkey, who was shot and killed in a 2021 road-rage incident. The video made clear that it featured an AI version of Pelkey, an Army veteran who was 37 when he was killed.
"It is a shame we encountered each other that day in those circumstances," the Pelkey avatar says in the video. "In another life, we probably could have been friends." The avatar told the court that the video was the “true representation of who I was.”
Pelkey’s sister Stacey Wales [USN:L1N3RG1LO TEXT:"told Reuters last year"] that she scripted the AI-generated message. She said her goal was “to humanize Chris, to reach the judge, and let him know his impact on this world and that he existed.”

items.title: El organismo de control de la Fed no encuentra pruebas de delitos en la renovación de su sede
items.author: Enda Curran
items.summary: El proyecto de renovación recibió duras críticas del presidente Donald Trump y de legisladores republicanos, quienes acusaron a la Reserva Federal de gastos excesivos y diseños extravagantes.
items.body: Bloomberg — El organismo de control interno de la Reserva Federal no encontró pruebas de irregularidades penales en la renovación de la sede central del banco central en Washington, un proyecto de US$2.400 millones que se convirtió en un punto de conflicto entre la Reserva Federal y la administración Trump cuando el presidente presionó para que se bajaran las tasas de interés el año pasado. Las conclusiones se recogen en un informe publicado el miércoles por la Oficina del Inspector General, que identifica una serie de errores que provocaron un aumento desmesurado de los costos de la renovación, que inicialmente se habían presupuestado en US$1.300 millones en 2020. Ver más: Dólar sube 1,9% en septiembre y cierra su mejor mes desde junio por expectativas de tasas de la Fed “En ningún momento de nuestra evaluación encontramos motivos razonables para creer que se hubiera producido una violación de la ley penal federal que requiriera una remisión al Fiscal General de los Estados Unidos de conformidad con la Ley del Inspector General”, declaró la OIG. “Además, si bien nuestro informe describe deficiencias en la gestión del proyecto de renovación, lo que dio lugar a las medidas correctivas que recomendamos de conformidad con la Ley del Inspector General, no identificamos ninguna mala conducta administrativa durante nuestra evaluación”. En una respuesta incluida en el informe, el presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, dijo que el banco central implementaría sus recomendaciones y que la Administración de Servicios Generales, que ayuda a administrar los edificios del gobierno federal, se haría cargo del proyecto, rindiendo cuentas a la Junta de Gobernadores de la Reserva Federal y a Warsh. “Hay lecciones importantes que aprender, y esas lecciones, combinadas con sus conclusiones y con las recomendaciones de la GSA, tendrán un valor permanente para nuestros sucesores en la Junta de Gobernadores”, escribió Warsh en una carta a Michael Horowitz, el inspector general que fue nombrado para el cargo por Powell en junio de 2025. La Reserva Federal también contratará a un auditor independiente para que examine detenidamente todos los costos adjudicados hasta la fecha, dijo Warsh. Entre sus conclusiones, el organismo de control determinó que la junta directiva de la Reserva Federal no actuó ante las deficiencias relacionadas con los sobrecostos de un proyecto anterior. En concreto, tras la revisión realizada por la Oficina del Inspector General (OIG) de la renovación del edificio William McChesney Martin Jr. de la Reserva Federal, la junta no implementó la recomendación de imponer un límite de costos. Tampoco solicitó una estimación de los costos de construcción. Ver más: Williams, de la Fed, apunta a un alza más de tasas a finales de 2026 para contener la inflación En julio, cuatro años después del inicio del proyecto y de la adjudicación de las licitaciones, la Reserva Federal aún no había establecido un precio máximo garantizado. Otros problemas señalados por la Oficina del Inspector General incluyeron aumentos sustanciales de costos debido a la falta de ofertas para algunos trabajos y una gobernanza interna que, según el informe, no estaba preparada para gestionar un proyecto de esta magnitud y complejidad. Los cambios en el diseño, las condiciones del terreno y la inflación fueron otros factores citados por la OIG. “Hemos constatado que la inflación fue claramente un factor en el aumento de costos al que se enfrentó la junta directiva”, junto con otros problemas, según indica el informe. Entre las recomendaciones se incluyen garantizar que se tomen las medidas necesarias para obtener el mejor valor posible a medida que se completa el trabajo, establecer una métrica de éxito en cuanto a costos y plazos del proyecto, y delegar la responsabilidad a un organismo de supervisión para controlar la implementación de los costos y los plazos. El proyecto de renovación recibió duras críticas del presidente Donald Trump y de legisladores republicanos, quienes acusaron a la Reserva Federal de gastos excesivos y diseños extravagantes. Estas acusaciones fueron seguidas de una investigación penal contra el entonces presidente de la Reserva Federal, Jerome Powell, por su gestión del proyecto. La fiscal federal del Distrito de Columbia, Jeanine Pirro, archivó la investigación en abril después de que legisladores de ambos partidos presentaran objeciones. Tim Lauer, portavoz de Pirro, declaró el miércoles que la oficina “acaba de recibir el informe de la Oficina del Inspector General de la Reserva Federal y está en proceso de revisar el informe de 121 páginas”. Ver más: El PCE, indicador de inflación preferido de la Fed, sube 0,3% en agosto y el gasto se acelera Powell ordenó la revisión de la OIG en julio de 2025 en respuesta a las críticas a las renovaciones. Powell ya había reconocido los sobrecostos de las renovaciones, pero rechazó las insinuaciones de que el proyecto fuera extravagante. La cuestión radica en la renovación por parte de la Reserva Federal de dos edificios históricos: el Edificio Marriner S. Eccles, su sede original construida en 1937, y un edificio federal adyacente de 1931, adquirido por la Reserva Federal en los últimos años. El banco central ha declarado que las renovaciones se diseñaron para modernizar las estructuras antiguas y que, con el tiempo, reducirían los costos mediante la consolidación de sus operaciones. Las críticas al proyecto comenzaron a aumentar a lo largo de 2025. En respuesta, la Reserva Federal añadió y actualizó una sección de preguntas frecuentes en su sitio web dedicada al proyecto, donde explicaba el motivo del aumento de costos. Powell también cuestionó algunas de las características de diseño que los críticos señalaban. “No hay comedor VIP, no hay mármol nuevo”, dijo Powell a los legisladores en junio de 2025. “No hay ascensores especiales; solo hay ascensores viejos que ya estaban allí. No hay nuevas fuentes de agua, no hay colmenas ni jardines en la azotea”. El informe de la OIG indicó que características como el mármol, las fuentes de agua o una terraza ajardinada no fueron factores determinantes en el aumento de los costos. En julio de 2025, Trump visitó la obra junto con Powell. En aquel momento, el personal de la Reserva Federal afirmó que los elementos de seguridad, como las ventanas resistentes a explosiones, los muros de contención y las medidas de colapso progresivo, diseñados para cumplir con los estándares del Departamento de Seguridad Nacional, habían contribuido al aumento de los costos. Ver más: Banxico puede trazar la trayectoria de tasas de interés con independencia de la Fed: gobernadora En enero se produjo una escalada dramática cuando Powell declaró que el Departamento de Justicia había notificado al banco central citaciones del gran jurado que amenazaban con una acusación penal. En una contundente declaración escrita y en video, Powell acusó a la administración de haber iniciado la investigación en respuesta a la negativa de la Reserva Federal a bajar las tasas de interés a satisfacción de Trump. “La medida debe verse en el contexto más amplio de las amenazas y la presión constante del gobierno”, dijo Powell en aquel momento. Las repercusiones de la investigación amenazaban con descarrilar la transición de liderazgo de la Reserva Federal, ya que los legisladores republicanos retrasaron la audiencia de confirmación de Warsh hasta que Pirro archivó la investigación. Sin embargo, pocos días después de ese anuncio, Powell anunció que rompería con la tradición y permanecería en el banco central como gobernador una vez que expirara su mandato como presidente en mayo. “He dicho que no abandonaré la junta directiva hasta que esta investigación haya concluido de forma definitiva, con transparencia y de manera concluyente, y mantengo mi postura”, afirmó. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Petróleo sobe cerca de US$1 por barril com impasse nas negociações EUA-Irã
items.author: Laila Kearney
items.creator: Laila Kearney
items.summary: Os preços do petróleo subiram cerca de US$1 por barril nesta quarta-feira e registraram fortes ganhos mensais, devido ao impasse nas negociações de paz entre os Estados Unidos e o Irã e ao aperto nos mercados de combustíveis dos EUA.
items.body:
Os preços do petróleo subiram cerca de US$1 por barril nesta quarta-feira e registraram fortes ganhos mensais, devido ao impasse nas negociações de paz entre os Estados Unidos e o Irã e ao aperto nos mercados de combustíveis dos EUA.
O contrato futuro do Brent para novembro , com vencimento nesta quarta-feira, fechou com alta de 91 centavos, ou 0,9%, a US$103,50 por barril. O contrato mais ativo, para dezembro , subiu US$1,87, ou 1,9%, para US$98,03.
O petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos fechou a US$90,42, com alta de US$1,04, ou 1,2%.
O Brent registrou um ganho mensal de cerca de 14%, o maior desde julho, enquanto o WTI subiu cerca de 5% no mês.
O Catar afirmou na terça-feira que espera que a diplomacia itinerante entre Teerã e Washington possa levar a um avanço.
No entanto, o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, negou reportagens da Axios e da CNN que citavam autoridades americanas afirmando que ele estaria disposto a conceder alívio nas sanções ao Irã e liberar fundos iranianos congelados em troca de medidas “concretas” por parte de Teerã em relação ao seu programa nuclear.
A Arábia Saudita retomou na terça-feira o carregamento de petroleiros em seu porto de Yanbu, no Mar Vermelho, após reiniciar as operações do oleoduto Leste-Oeste.
O Goldman Sachs estima que as exportações de petróleo do Golfo tenham se recuperado para 23,3 milhões de barris por dia na última semana, em linha com a média prevista para 2025, já que as exportações dobraram em setembro, segundo nota divulgada na terça-feira.
Nos últimos cinco dias, a média de 10 dias para o total de exportações de petróleo se manteve em 20,5 milhões de bpd, ou 89% dos níveis de 2025, segundo estimativas do JPMorgan.
Os países produtores de petróleo da Opep+ provavelmente manterão suas metas de produção estáveis para novembro quando se reunirem no domingo, disseram à Reuters duas pessoas a par do assunto.

items.title: US Consumer Spending Jumps by Most in a Year
items.summary:
US consumer spending rose in August at the fastest pace in over a year, helping to power the economy through persistent inflation. Inflation-adjusted personal spending climbed 0.6% in August from a month earlier, according to Bureau of Economic Analysis data released on Wednesday. That was the biggest monthly jump since March 2025. We get reaction from Bloomberg's Mike McKee and Lindsey Piegza, Chief Economist at Stifel. Bruce Markets CEO Jason Wallach joins Bloomberg News' Bernard Goyder to discuss the company's role in Robinhood Markets' plan to debut weekend equity trading. Jennifer Palmer, Founder & CEO at JPalmer Collective, discusses the evolving non-bank lending landscape. All on the latest episode of "Bloomberg Businessweek Daily."
(Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Astros OF Daulton Varsho (wrist) done for season after surgery
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Houston Astros outfielder Daulton Varsho underwent arthroscopic surgery on his left wrist Tuesday and is done for the season.
items.body:
Houston Astros outfielder Daulton Varsho underwent arthroscopic surgery on his left wrist Tuesday and is done for the season.
He had been dealing with cysts in the wrist most of the season and was placed on the 10-day injured list on Sept. 24.
Varsho, 30, split the season with the Toronto Blue Jays (99 games) and Astros (41) and batted .221 with 12 homers and 40 RBIs in 140 games. He hit just .172 with Houston after being acquired at the trade deadline.
He is a career .226 hitter with 111 homers and 335 RBIs in 788 regular-season games with the Arizona Diamondbacks (2020-22), Blue Jays (2023-26) and Astros. He won a Gold Glove with Toronto in 2024.
Houston is hosting the Chicago White Sox in Game 2 of the American League wild-card series on Wednesday.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson 'dealing with something small'
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson raised initial concerns after he wasn't spotted during the beginning of practice open to the media on Wednesday.
items.body:
Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson raised initial concerns after he wasn't spotted during the beginning of practice open to the media on Wednesday.
Jackson eventually took the field -- albeit in a limited fashion -- prompting head coach Jesse Minter to open his press conference with an update on the status of the two-time NFL MVP.
"Lamar was at practice in a little limited role. Just dealing with something small," Minter said. "That was good. I had heard that maybe that was sheer pandemonium that he wasn't out there earlier. He ended up being able to get some stuff done."
Jackson, 29, has completed 69.7% of his passes (53 of 76) for 745 yards with four touchdowns and one interception in three games for the Ravens (2-1), who host the Tennessee Titans (0-3) on Sunday.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Pennsylvania Reports Fifth Measles Death in Widening Crisis
items.author: list.metadata.agency
items.summary: Pennsylvania has reported its fifth measles-associated death this year, as the US continues to suffer through its worst outbreak in decades.
items.body: (Bloomberg) -- Pennsylvania has reported its fifth measles-associated death this year, as the US continues to suffer through its worst outbreak in decades. In a statement Wednesday, the state’s Department of Health said the fifth death was in an unvaccinated Lancaster County resident. Pennsylvania is the hardest hit state in the US. The announcement comes as the state and federal health agencies have been feuding over whether the deaths are measles related. After Pennsylvania notified the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention about its first two measles-related deaths in August, Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. publicly questioned them and suggested Democratic Governor Josh Shapiro fabricated the deaths for political gain. Shapiro then blamed Kennedy for sowing distrust in vaccines. The CDC at first declined to include the deaths in its official measles outbreak tally. It’s subsequently included two of them. The CDC and HHS did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Pennsylvania hadn’t recorded a measles-related death in 35 years before this summer. The state’s outbreak has now hit 943 cases this year, with 176 people hospitalized. Less than 1% of the confirmed cases happened in people who’d been fully vaccinated against measles.The US’s total measles cases are at a 35-year high, with 3,669 confirmed cases in 45 states as of Sept. 24. Pennsylvania’s health department stresses that the best protection against measles is to get two doses of the combined measles, mumps and rubella shot, which prevents 97% of infections. Unvaccinated people are at risk of pneumonia and brain swelling from the highly contagious respiratory virus. In August, President Donald Trump signed an executive order recommending that the MMR vaccine be split into three shots. If implemented, this would force parents to make more trips to the doctor to get the same protection against diseases for their young children, which could raise the risk that some miss immunizations.(Updated with background and case numbers from the sixth paragraph.)More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

items.title: Report: Amazon agrees to extend Kirk Herbstreit's contract but can replace him
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kirk Herbstreit has agreed to a contract extension to remain in the broadcast booth on "Thursday Night Football" on Amazon Prime Video, which can replace him if another choice for game analyst becomes available, The Athletic reported on Wednesday.
items.body:
Kirk Herbstreit has agreed to a contract extension to remain in the broadcast booth on "Thursday Night Football" on Amazon Prime Video, which can replace him if another choice for game analyst becomes available, The Athletic reported on Wednesday.
Top alternatives could include current Los Angeles Rams coach Sean McVay, who has spoken publicly about a future in television. The musical chairs in the announcer booths could include ESPN analyst Troy Aikman and Fox analyst Greg Olsen, who are in the final years of their contracts, and current Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce, should he retire, The Athletic article noted.
The caveat in Herbstreit's new deal, which is for multiple seasons and eight figures annually, per The Athletic, comes as he is at the end of his initial five-year contract with Prime Video. McVay, now 40, reportedly was recruited by Prime Video before it hired Herbstreit five years ago.
Herbstreit, 57, also is in the final season of his contract with ESPN, for whom he is a long-running commentator on "College GameDay" and is slotted as the network's top college football game analyst. ESPN will address Herbstreit's contract status after this college football season, per the report.
A former Ohio State quarterback (1989-92) who did not play in the NFL, Herbstreit has been with ESPN for more than three decades. He has been doing double duty as an NFL commentator with iconic play-by-play caller Al Michaels, 81, who is on year-to-year contracts, per The Athletic.
According to the report, Prime Video in 2022 was interested in McVay, Aikman and San Francisco 49ers general manager John Lynch for the game analyst position, while Michaels favored his former broadcast partner Cris Collinsworth, who chose to stay with NBC's "Sunday Night Football."
--Field Level Media

items.title: Most U.S. stocks fall after the bond market cranks the pressure even higher
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: Some of the pressure that’s ballooned in the bond market is easing on Wednesday after a report said inflation across the United States wasn’t as bad last month as economists expected.
items.body: NEW YORK — Most of the U.S. stock market fell Wednesday as Wall Street contended with the downside of a U.S. economy that keeps powering through its many challenges. The S&P 500 slipped 0.3 per cent to close out its third losing month in the last four. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 443 points, or 0.9 per cent, and the Nasdaq composite added 0.2 per cent. Stocks turned lower after data reports suggested the U.S. economy was even stronger during the spring than earlier thought. That helped yields remain high in the bond market, which in turn kept up the pressure weighing on stocks and all financial markets. The day began with gains for stocks following an encouraging report that said inflation wasn’t as bad across the United States last month as economists expected. It said the cost of living for U.S. consumers was 3.4 per cent higher overall in August than a year earlier. That was not as high as the 3.7 per cent inflation rate that economists expected, even if it remained worse than the Fed’s 2 per cent target. The report followed others from earlier in the month about inflation during August, but it’s the one that the Federal Reserve prefers to use. Shorter-term Treasury yields fell as traders pared bets that the Fed will raise its main interest rate next month to get inflation further under control. They now see just a 37 per cent chance of that, down from the coin flip’s chance seen a day earlier, according to data from CME Group. That helped the yield on the two-year Treasury briefly fall toward 4.83 per cent before it pulled back to 4.89 per cent, where it was late Tuesday. But longer-term yields rose in the bond market. That’s in part because worries about high inflation are just one of the reasons longer-term yields have jumped in the United States and around the world. The seemingly solid U.S. economy is another. Besides Wednesday’s better-than-expected report on the overall U.S. economy, another update said growth in business activity in the Midwest was also stronger than economists expected. Much of the strength in the U.S. economy is due to consumers, who are increasing their spending by more than their incomes are rising. “The consumer remains resilient, in a much better position than previously thought,” according to Gary Schlossberg, global strategist at Wells Fargo Investment Institute. Other factors sending Treasury yields higher are also continuing to churn, including worries about the big debt loads that Washington and other governments worldwide are supporting. Oil prices, meanwhile, rose in their latest swings amid uncertainty about when the war with Iran will allow the flow of crude to be fully restored. Brent crude, the international standard, climbed 1.9 per cent to settle at US$98.03 per barrel. It all helped the yield on the 10-year Treasury, which is the centerpiece of the bond market, drop as low as 5.20 per cent in the morning before rising to 5.29 per cent. That’s up from 5.26 per cent late Tuesday, and it’s back to where it was more than two decades ago in 2002. The 30-year Treasury yield, which takes into account expectations for inflation and economic growth many years down the line, climbed to 5.64 per cent from 5.59 per cent late Tuesday. Higher yields slow the overall economy by making borrowing money more expensive for everyone, while undercutting prices for all kinds of investments. On Wall Street, Cal-Maine Foods dropped 0.7 per cent after the country’s largest egg company reported a larger loss for the latest quarter than analysts expected. With plenty of eggs available in the market, Cal-Maine Foods saw a sharp drop in prices it could charge, compared with a year earlier. Helping to limit the market’s losses was Hewlett Packard Enterprise, which rose 3.9 per cent. It increased its forecast for revenue from its networking business, which is benefiting from the boom in artificial-intelligence technology. MongoDB climbed 3.4 per cent after the database company’s board boosted its program to send cash to shareholders by US$1 billion through buybacks of its own stock. That helped MongoDB recover some of its sharp loss from earlier in the week, after it said Chirantan “CJ” Desai was stepping down as CEO for a senior role at Meta Platforms. All told, the S&P 500 fell 19.30 points to 7,651.54. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 443.87 to 50,906.05, and the Nasdaq composite added 63.52 to 26,861.06. In stock markets abroad, indexes dipped in Europe following a mixed finish in Asia. Japan’s Nikkei 225 jumped 1.9 per cent, while France’s CAC 40 fell 0.9 per cent for two of the world’s bigger moves. ___ Stan Choe, The Associated Press AP Business Writers Yuri Kageyama and Michelle Chapman contributed to this report.

items.title: Parlamento de Portugal aprova despejos mais rápidos e fim dos limites para aluguéis
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Parlamento português aprovou nesta quarta-feira, em primeira votação, uma polêmica reforma do mercado de aluguéis que visa acelerar os despejos e acabar com os controles de aluguel nos novos contratos, numa medida que o governo de centro-direita espera que incentive os proprietários a colocar mais imóveis no mercado.
items.body:
O Parlamento português aprovou nesta quarta-feira, em primeira votação, uma polêmica reforma do mercado de aluguéis que visa acelerar os despejos e acabar com os controles de aluguel nos novos contratos, numa medida que o governo de centro-direita espera que incentive os proprietários a colocar mais imóveis no mercado.
A reforma, criticada por associações de inquilinos como “barbárie”, contrasta fortemente com os acontecimentos na vizinha Espanha, onde o governo de esquerda decretou, na terça-feira, a proibição de despejos de inquilinos vulneráveis até 2030, juntamente com outras medidas, em meio a protestos contra despejos e o aumento dos aluguéis.
As linhas gerais da reforma foram aprovadas graças à abstenção do partido de extrema-direita Chega, que também havia manifestado suas objeções durante o debate, enquanto todos os partidos de esquerda votaram contra.

items.title: Toyota invertirá 1.341 millones de dólares en una planta de producción en Argentina
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El fabricante de automóviles Toyota Motor invertirá 1.341 millones de dólares en la construcción de una planta de producción en Argentina, anunció el miércoles el ministro de Economía, Luis Caputo.
items.body:
El fabricante de automóviles Toyota Motor (7203.T) invertirá 1.341 millones de dólares en la construcción de una planta de producción en Argentina, anunció el miércoles el ministro de Economía, Luis Caputo.
La planta fabricará un vehículo totalmente eléctrico, dijo Caputo, que añadió que se espera que genere 1.280 millones de dólares en exportaciones anuales y cree más de 2.600 puestos de trabajo durante su fase operativa.
El proyecto fue aprobado bajo el esquema del Régimen de Incentivo para Grandes Inversiones (RIGI) y representa la inversión más grande de la historia en la industria automotriz de Argentina, agregó el ministro.

items.title: Stella McCartney spotlights climate crisis with ocean-inspired Paris runway show
items.author: Helen Reid
items.creator: Helen Reid
items.summary: Stella McCartney put a spotlight on the impact of overfishing and climate change on the oceans in her Paris runway show on Wednesday, unveiling a Spring/Summer 2027 collection of floaty fabrics, bubble hems and wave motifs.
items.body:
Stella McCartney put a spotlight on the impact of overfishing and climate change on the oceans in her Paris runway show on Wednesday, unveiling a Spring/Summer 2027 collection of floaty fabrics, bubble hems and wave motifs.
Killer whales, sharks and dolphins featured on several looks, while models carried transparent handbags with sea creatures such as a starfish inside.
"The fishing industry is stealth, it's war, we're at war with the ocean, we're at war with the creatures that live in there," McCartney, a vegetarian, said after the show, adding that she wanted people to ask themselves: "Sea life or seafood — what's my choice?"
McCartney's eponymous brand is known for using no leather, unlike most luxury labels, and for investing in more sustainably produced cotton, wool and other materials. Her handbags are made with leather alternatives produced from mushrooms or grape byproducts sourced from vineyards.
In the leafy gardens of the British ambassador's residence, the show started with a voiceover from British natural historian and broadcaster David Attenborough saying: "We must open our eyes to what is happening right now below the waves - we have drained the life from our ocean."
Models strode down a white runway in low-rise trousers with raised waves embroidered on the hips, tops with voluminous bubble hems, and fluid, sheer blazers and shirts. The colour palette also evoked ocean life with dresses in aqua and bright blue, and a coral trench coat.
McCartney, who bought her brand back from luxury giant LVMH at the start of last year, called on big luxury brands to invest in scaling up more sustainable materials like organic cotton or lab-grown wool.
"I think they all have good intentions, I just know that it would help me and smaller brands trying to come up and trying to work in this way, if the big brands just accepted a new way of working and a new supply chain," she said.

items.title: Republican US Senator Blackburn blocks Trump's pick for judge in Tennessee
items.author: Nate Raymond
items.creator: Nate Raymond
items.summary: US Senator Marsha Blackburn has taken the rare step as a Republican lawmaker of blocking at least for now one of US President Donald Trump's judicial nominees by withholding support for a White House lawyer nominated to serve on the bench in her home state.
items.body:
US Senator Marsha Blackburn has taken the rare step as a Republican lawmaker of blocking at least for now one of US President Donald Trump's judicial nominees by withholding support for a White House lawyer nominated to serve on the bench in her home state.
Samuel Adkisson, who serves in the White House Counsel's Office as an associate counsel, had been expected to appear before the Senate Judiciary Committee on Wednesday in connection with his nomination last month by Trump to become a judge on the US District Court for the Eastern District of Tennessee.
But the panel did not take up Adkisson's nomination after Blackburn, a member of the committee who is running to be Tennessee's governor, did not return a so-called "blue slip" supporting his nomination, according to a committee aide.
Senators must return blue slips, named for the color of the forms, to the Senate Judiciary Committee in order for district court judge nominees from their home states to be considered, giving the senators leverage over who the White House picks.
It was unclear why Blackburn, who was not at Wednesday's hearing, did not submit a blue slip supporting Adkisson, who previously worked under Senator Chuck Grassley in his role as the panel's chairman during US Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh's 2018 confirmation hearing.
Representatives for Blackburn, Grassley and the White House did not respond to requests for comment.
In nominating Adkisson, Trump in a social media post last month credited him for his work on "numerous important cases," highlighting his work in particular on [USN:L1N4310PO TEXT:"Trump v. Slaughter"], in which the high court in June said the president had broad authority to fire regulatory agency heads.
Tennessee's other Republican senator, Bill Hagerty, had at the time of Adkisson's nomination hailed the choice, noting he had previously also served as a law clerk to Supreme Court Chief Justice John Roberts. Blackburn did not comment publicly on the nomination.
Mike Davis, a Trump ally who runs the conservative group the Article III Project, in a post on X late Tuesday called Blackburn's decision to block Adkisson a "stunning development" and a "grave mistake."
"We could not get a more brilliant, conservative, bold, and fearless pick for the federal bench," Davis wrote.
Adkisson was not the only nominee to be absent from Wednesday's hearing, the last scheduled on judicial nominees before the November 2 midterm elections in which Democrats hope to [USN:L1N4500N3 TEXT:"reclaim control"] of the Republican-led Senate.
Grassley kicked the session off by saying that due to delays in getting background investigation paperwork from the FBI, Brad Kelley, a partner at law firm Littler Mendelson, nominated to a judgeship in the Eastern District of Louisiana, would also not be considered at the meeting.
"This was a delay in getting paperwork from the FBI, and I’m confident that Mr. Kelley will sit for our next hearing," Grassley said.

items.title: Smiles and respect as Fury and Joshua have first face off ahead of December fight
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: Former heavyweight world champions Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua came face to face on Wednesday as their long-awaited clash finally looked real after years of doubt, even in recent days, that they would ever get it together.
items.body:
Former heavyweight world champions Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua came face to face on Wednesday as their long-awaited clash finally looked real after years of doubt, even in recent days, that they would ever get it together.
The pair, 38 and 36 years old respectively and veterans some way past their prime, are due to meet at Cardiff's Principality Stadium on December 11 with tickets going on sale on October 9.
Appearing together at a London 'news conference' -- although the only reporter who tried to ask a question from the floor was told 'no journalists' by Joshua -- the two big men showed mutual respect mixed with fighting talk and occasional digs at each other without losing their calm.
With doors also opened to the public and a rowdy crowd in attendance for a show with lights and fireworks, Joshua called for a minute's silence for two close friends[USN:L1N3XZ09S TEXT:" killed in a car crash"] in Nigeria late last year.
The catcalls and heckling stopped immediately, the Olympia hall completely hushed as the time ticked past.
OLD SPARRING STORIES AND BLACK EYES Fury, the 'Gypsy King', was asked earlier about singing Joshua's praises after a sparring session years ago when his opponent was still in the amateur ranks and when he offered him a Rolex watch if he could knock him down.
"Guess what? I left that building with a Rolex on," said Fury with a smile. Joshua, in dark glasses and a white T-shirt, added his own postscript that Fury had also left with a black eye.
The respectful mood continued, with Fury shunning much of his usual bombast: "This man is a two-time heavyweight world champion, Olympic gold medallist and he has been a role model and a poster boy for British boxing for years," he declared of Joshua.
"I mostly find myself defending my arch rival to fans I meet in the street and I say to them if you could achieve 10% of what this man has achieved, you'd be doing well. That aside, we're here to fight and fight we will, and I'm looking forward to the challenge. It's been 10 years in the making."
The older Briton described himself as "bald, fat, bearded, ugly, slow and ponderous", to which Joshua laughingly replied "it's true".
"Whatever people want to say," continued Fury. "But at the end of the day I get shit done.
"This man is built like an Adonis and I'm built like a blancmange," he added. "He's made of marble, but every time he gets cracked on the jaw, he falls over. And when I crack him on that jaw, he's going to go down like a ton of bricks."
Both men spoke of the significance of holding the fight in Britain rather than in the United States or Saudi Arabia, with Netflix providing the platform and Ring Magazine owner and Saudi promoter Turki Alalshikh the money man making it happen.
Fury said it would be the "biggest of our time and of our generation".
"It's an unbelievable event, because it's been simmering nicely for a decade and a half," he added. "We've had our ups and downs, and finally now near the end of it all, we get to fight each other."
The final face off for the cameras ended in smiles, with Joshua pretending to tickle Fury who had suggested earlier that they might even go for a pint once the fight was done.

items.title: Senators will try to win approval of permanent Chinese car ban in November
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: The two US senators backing a permanent legislative ban on Chinese vehicles in the US will not seek approval until the Senate returns from recess in November, congressional aides said Wednesday.
items.body:
The two US senators backing a permanent legislative ban on Chinese vehicles in the US will not seek approval until the Senate returns from recess in November, congressional aides said Wednesday.
Republican Senator Bernie Moreno said on Tuesday that he planned to seek fast-track approval for the stringent ban on Chinese vehicles this week before the Senate left ahead of the November congressional election . But supporters were unable to address the concerns of a holdout senator, Republican Rand Paul, who had raised concerns it was unfairly targeting Mercedes-Benz.
The bill's other chief sponsor, Democratic Senator Elissa Slotkin, said last week that all Democrats support moving ahead and she was hoping to get fast-track approval this week.
Moreno said on Tuesday the final version of the bill would ensure that German automaker Mercedes-Benz (MBGn.DE) is not banned from selling vehicles in the US.
The bill approved by the Senate Commerce Committee in July would ban companies with more than 15% ownership by Chinese entities from selling vehicles in the US. Mercedes-Benz has nearly 20% passive ownership from Chinese entities.
The bill has significant momentum and a House version now tops 100 co-sponsors, while automakers and legislative aides hope to win full passage this year.
President Donald Trump told Fox News earlier this month that he would accept Chinese car companies building cars in the US, sparking alarm among automakers. Automakers, suppliers and dealers have urged Trump "to maintain policies that keep the door firmly shut to Chinese automakers seeking to sell, import or manufacture vehicles inside the US."
A regulation imposed by the former Biden administration in early 2025 effectively banned all Chinese automakers from selling or building passenger vehicles in the US because they could send sensitive driver data to China. Washington also maintains more than 100% tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles.
The Chinese foreign ministry has previously urged the United States "to respect the laws of the market economy and principles of fair competition," criticizing previous proposals against Chinese companies as "unreasonable suppression."

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　３０日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対しほぼ横ばいで推移した。米インフレ指標が市場予想を下回る伸びとなり、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による利上げ観測が後退した。

米商務省経済分析局（ＢＥＡ）が３０日発表した８月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．４％上昇し、７月の３．４％上昇から横ばいとなった。伸びは市場予想を下回り、７月分も当初の３．７％上昇から下方改定された。ＰＣＥ発表後、ドルは一時上げ幅を縮小した。

ＢＮＹマーケッツのジョン・ベリス氏は、ＰＣＥが予想を下回る内容となったことについて「ＰＣＥデータが改定されたことか、それとも他の要素が原因なのかは判断できない。いずれにせよ当初は債券が買われ、利回りが低下し、ドルは下落した」と述べた。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場が織り込む１０月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ確率は３７％と、１週間前の７０％から低下した。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は横ばいの１０１．４７。月間では上昇の見通しで、２カ月連続の下落から反発する見込み。

ドルは対円で横ばいの１５７．３４円。対スイスフランでは０．２６％高の０．８３５７５フランと、月間では２カ月連続の上昇となる見通し。

英ポンドは対ドルで１．３２６５ドルと０．２６％上昇したものの、月間ベースでは下落する見通し。

ユーロは横ばいの１．１３３０５０ドル。

items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米半導体メモリーメーカー、マイクロン・テクノロジーが示した9－11月（第1四半期）の売上高見通しが市場予想を上回った。AIインフラ増強がかつてない需要を生み出している。

9月30日の発表資料によると、9－11月の売上高は約615億ドルとなる見通し。アナリスト予想の平均は568億ドルだった。一部項目を除く1株利益は約38.15ドルを見込む。市場予想は36.02ドル。

マイクロンの株価は決算発表後の時間外取引で一時1%未満の上昇となった。今年すでにフィラデルフィア半導体株指数（SOX）の構成銘柄で上昇率首位となっていた。

原題：Micron Forecast Tops Estimates After Demand Outstrips

items.title: Portugal parliament backs swifter evictions, end of rent caps
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Portugal's parliament approved on Wednesday, in the first reading, a contentious rental market overhaul aimed to speed up evictions and end rent controls on new leases in what the centre-right government hopes will encourage landlords to put more homes on the market.
items.body:
Portugal's parliament approved on Wednesday, in the first reading, a contentious rental market overhaul aimed to speed up evictions and end rent controls on new leases in what the centre-right government hopes will encourage landlords to put more homes on the market.
The reform, criticised by tenants' associations as "savagery", sharply contrasts with developments in neighbouring Spain where the leftist government on Tuesday [USN:L1N45L0A6 TEXT:"decreed"] a ban on evictions of vulnerable tenants until 2030, along with other measures, amid protests against evictions and rising rents.
The general outline of the reform was approved thanks to the abstention of the far-right party Chega, which had also expressed its objections during the debate, while all of the left-wing parties voted against.

items.title: 米国株式市場＝まちまち、Ｓ＆Ｐとナスダックは2四半期連続高
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　３０日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はナスダック総合が上昇する一方、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種は小幅下落した。両...
items.body:
米国株式市場＝まちまち、Ｓ＆Ｐとナスダックは2四半期連続高
5:15 配信

2026年4月17日撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid//File Photo

［ニューヨーク　３０日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はナスダック総合が上昇する一方、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種は小幅下落した。両指数とも四半期では２期連続で上昇した。８月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数の伸びが市場予想を下回ったことを受け、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による１０月の追加利上げ観測が後退した。

米商務省経済分析局（ＢＥＡ）が３０日発表した８月のＰＣＥ価格指数は前年比３．４％上昇し、７月の３．４％上昇から横ばいとなった。７月分も当初の３．７％上昇から下方改定された。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、１０月の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で少なくとも２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げが行われる確率は約３７％に低下した。前日は約５１％、１週間前は約７１％だった。

商務省が発表した第２・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）確報値は年率換算で前期比２．２％増と、改定値の１．５％増から上方修正された。個人消費や人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラ整備に関連する企業投資が寄与した。

アメリプライズ・ファイナンシャルのチーフマーケットストラテジスト、アンソニー・サグリンベネ氏は「市場が注目しているのは、経済が成長を続けているか、そして高金利に耐えられるかという点だ。これまでの市場の動きは、過去の経験におおむね沿っている。経済が成長し、企業利益が堅調で、長期的な成長テーマがあれば、市場は高金利をさほど問題視しない」と指摘。

一方で「高金利が長期化すれば、ポートフォリオの債券部分への悪影響が一段と大きくなり始め、信用供給が制限される可能性がある。こうした状況が今後１─２四半期に経済成長や企業収益を圧迫すると投資家が感じ始めれば、市場は極めて急速に悪化するだろう」と語った。

Ｓ＆Ｐは月間で０．４５％下落、ナスダックは１．８６％上昇、ダウは４．２９％下落した。ダウの月間連続上昇は５カ月で途切れ、Ｓ＆Ｐは過去４カ月のうち３カ月で下落した。一方、ナスダックは２カ月連続で上昇した。

Ｓ＆Ｐとナスダックはともに２四半期連続で上昇し、過去６四半期のうち５期でプラスとなった。ダウは過去３四半期で２度目の下落となった。

マイクロソフト、アップル、エヌビディアなど大型株や成長株の多くが上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ情報技術株指数を押し上げた。ただ、Ｓ＆Ｐの主要１１セクターのうち９セクターは下落して取引を終えた。

ＡＩサーバーを手がけるヒューレット・パッカード・エンタープライズ（ＨＰＥ）は３．９％高。ネットワーク事業の長期の売上高成長率見通しを引き上げたほか、バルチャーとの１２億ドルの契約を発表した。

バイオ医薬品のモデルナは５．３％下落。シティグループが投資判断を「中立」から「売り」に引き下げた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．６６対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．５１対１で値下がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は１８１億３０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７０億６０００万株。

items.title: Google anuncia su modelo insignia de IA, Gemini 4, tras meses de retrasos
items.author: Kenrick Cai
items.creator: Kenrick Cai
items.summary: Google , filial de Alphabet, anunció el miércoles un nuevo modelo de inteligencia artificial de gama alta que servirá de pilar para su nueva generación de modelos "Gemini 4", en un nuevo intento por alcanzar a sus rivales Anthropic y OpenAI en la carrera por la IA.
items.body:
Google (GOOGL.O) , filial de Alphabet, anunció el miércoles un nuevo modelo de inteligencia artificial de gama alta que servirá de pilar para su nueva generación de modelos "Gemini 4", en un nuevo intento por alcanzar a sus rivales Anthropic y OpenAI en la carrera por la IA.
El nuevo modelo "Argon" es de mayor tamaño que la anterior línea de modelos "Pro" de gama alta de Google, según ha declarado un portavoz de la empresa.
"Es nuestro modelo más potente hasta la fecha, diseñado para cargas de trabajo complejas, y lo consideramos comparable a modelos de vanguardia como Astra (de OpenAI) y Opus (de Anthropic) en pruebas clave de codificación y ciberseguridad", afirmó el portavoz.
Google ha indicado que está facilitando el modelo a socios seleccionados del ámbito de la ciberseguridad y que participa en el proceso voluntario del Gobierno de Donald Trump para el acceso a modelos antes de su lanzamiento. No ha facilitado una fecha prevista para el lanzamiento público del modelo.

items.title: Australia win rain-curtailed ODI against South Africa
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Australia’s bowlers powered the tourists to a 45-run victory over South Africa under the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method on Wednesday, helping them avoid a whitewash in the three-match one-day international series.
items.body:
Australia’s bowlers powered the tourists to a 45-run victory over South Africa under the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method on Wednesday, helping them avoid a whitewash in the three-match one-day international series.
With test captain Pat Cummins competing in his first ODI in 22 months and Mitchell Starc restored to the team, Australia fielded a formidable attack after losing the opening two matches.
But it was Xavier Bartlett, who removed both openers and finished with 2-25 from five overs, and Adam Zampa, who took 2-34 from six, who effectively stifled home hopes of chasing down a challenging target at the JB Marks Oval after Australia were put in to bat and scored 322-9.
Rain brought a premature end to proceedings with South Africa on 145-4 after 28 overs, 46 runs short of their revised target of 191. Ryan Rickelton was unbeaten on 71 but running out of partners in a depleted batting line-up.
South Africa rested captain Temba Bavuma, David Miller and Marco Jansen and saw Tony de Zorzi hurt his hamstring while fielding, which meant he could not bat.
The wet weather also delayed the start of play, but Australia saw off any advantage South Africa hoped to gain out of the wicket with a 78-run partnership off 53 balls for the opening wicket between skipper Mitchell Marsh (56) and Travis Head (24).
The 20-year-old Oliver Peake contributed 48, while Alex Carey top-scored with 74 to push Australia to an imposing total.
South Africa won the first ODI in Durban by 67 runs and the second in Johannesburg by 32 runs. The two countries will now contest a three-test series starting in Durban next week.

items.title: S&P 500 recua, enquanto Nasdaq sobe após dados indicarem aumento moderado da inflação
items.author: Chuck Mikolajczak, Shashwat Chauhan
items.creator: Chuck Mikolajczak, Shashwat Chauhan
items.summary: O Nasdaq subiu nesta quarta-feira e o S&P 500 recuou, mas ambos os índices registraram seus segundos ganhos trimestrais consecutivos, já que um dado de inflação mais fraco do que o esperado amenizou as expectativas de que os formuladores de política monetária do Federal Reserve aumentem as taxas de juros em outubro.
items.body:
O Nasdaq subiu nesta quarta-feira e o S&P 500 recuou, mas ambos os índices registraram seus segundos ganhos trimestrais consecutivos, já que um dado de inflação mais fraco do que o esperado amenizou as expectativas de que os formuladores de política monetária do Federal Reserve aumentem as taxas de juros em outubro.
O Departamento de Comércio dos EUA informou que o Índice de Preços de Despesas de Consumo Pessoal (PCE) subiu 3,4% na base anual em agosto, ficando abaixo da estimativa de 3,7% dos economistas consultados pela Reuters.
Por outro lado, a estimativa final dos dados do PIB do segundo trimestre foi revisada para cima, para uma taxa anualizada de 2,2%, graças aos sólidos gastos do consumidor e aos investimentos que ajudaram a impulsionar a expansão da infraestrutura de IA.
O aumento dos preços do petróleo bruto devido ao conflito entre os EUA e o Irã e os altíssimos custos do diesel alimentaram os temores de inflação e empurraram os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos EUA para cima. Autoridades do Fed indicaram que mais aumentos nas taxas de juros podem ser necessários caso as pressões sobre os preços não se moderem após o banco central ter elevado as taxas de juros em 25 pontos-base neste mês.
O rendimento do título do Tesouro dos EUA de 2 anos , que normalmente acompanha as expectativas de taxas de juros do Fed, inicialmente recuou após a divulgação dos dados, antes de voltar a subir levemente, enquanto os rendimentos de títulos de prazo mais longo continuaram subindo devido às expectativas de um crescimento econômico sólido.
As expectativas do mercado de um aumento de pelo menos 25 pontos-base na reunião do Fed em outubro caíram para cerca de 39%, de acordo com a ferramenta FedWatch da CME, ante aproximadamente 51% na sessão anterior e quase 71% há uma semana.
Analistas também observaram que mudanças recentes na metodologia de cálculo do PCE pelo Bureau de Análise Econômica contribuíram para um resultado mais baixo.
“O que o mercado está focando é: a economia continua crescendo e será que ela consegue lidar com essas taxas de juros mais altas? E eu diria que, até agora, o mercado tem se comportado de maneira semelhante ao que já foi observado no passado: quando a economia está crescendo, quando os lucros são sólidos e quando há uma tendência de longo prazo, ele ignora as taxas de juros mais altas”, disse Anthony Saglimbene, estrategista-chefe de mercado da Ameriprise Financial em Troy, Michigan.
“No entanto... se essas taxas mais altas permanecerem nesses níveis elevados por mais tempo, é provável que comecem a causar danos potencialmente maiores ao segmento de títulos da carteira, o que poderia limitar o crédito ou o crédito disponível. E se os investidores começarem a perceber que essas condições podem pesar sobre o crescimento econômico ou sobre a lucratividade das empresas nos próximos um ou dois trimestres, então acredito que veremos uma reação negativa muito rápida no mercado.”
S&P E NASDAQ REGISTRAM GANHOS TRIMESTRAIS O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caiu 0,86%, para 50.906,05 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) perdeu 0,25%, para 7.651,54 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) subiu 0,24%, para 26.861,06 pontos. O S&P chegou a subir 0,7%, enquanto o Nasdaq chegou a 1,2% de alta durante o pregão.
No mês, o S&P 500 caiu 0,45%, o Nasdaq subiu 1,86% e o Dow Jones caiu 4,29%. O Dow Jones interrompeu uma sequência de cinco meses de ganhos, enquanto o S&P 500 registrou queda pelo terceiro mês em quatro. O Nasdaq registrou alta pelo segundo mês consecutivo.
Tanto o S&P 500 quanto o Nasdaq registraram seus segundos avanços trimestrais consecutivos e o quinto nos últimos seis. O Dow sofreu uma queda trimestral pela segunda vez em três.
A maioria das ações de megacapitalização e de crescimento registrou alta, com a Microsoft (MSFT.O) , a Apple (AAPL.O) e a Nvidia (NVDA.O) subindo, o que levou o índice de tecnologia do S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) a subir 0,6%, tornando-se o setor com melhor desempenho do dia. No entanto, nove dos 11 principais setores do S&P encerraram o dia em baixa.
EMPREGO NO SETOR PRIVADO CRESCE EM SETEMBRO Um relatório sobre o mercado de trabalho mostrou que o emprego no setor privado cresceu em 90.000 vagas neste mês, após uma revisão para baixo de 36.000 em agosto, segundo o Relatório Nacional de Emprego da ADP. Os dados foram os mais recentes de uma série de relatórios sobre o mercado de trabalho nesta semana, que culminarão no importante relatório governamental sobre os empregos, a ser divulgado na sexta-feira.
Sem abordar os dados de inflação mais fracos do que o esperado, a diretora do Fed Lisa Cook afirmou estar comprometida em reduzir a inflação sem prejudicar o mercado de trabalho, já que as pressões sobre os preços vêm sendo muito altas há muito tempo.
Entre outras empresas que se destacaram, a Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE.N) subiu 3,9% depois que a fabricante de servidores de IA elevou sua previsão de crescimento de receita de longo prazo para seu negócio de redes e anunciou um acordo de US$1,2 bilhão com a Vultr.
A Moderna (MRNA.O) tombou 5,3% depois que a corretora Citigroup rebaixou sua recomendação para a empresa de biotecnologia de “neutra” para “venda”.

Sept 30 : Micron Technology forecast quarterly revenue above estimates on Wednesday, signaling it expects the AI-driven memory chip boom to continue powering its growth.
Shares of the Boise, Idaho-based company rose over 1 per cent in extended trading. The stock has more than tripled so far this year.
The generative AI boom has made high-bandwidth memory essential for data centers, benefiting companies such as Micron, a key supplier to Nvidia, whose pricey processors dominate advanced computing workflows.
The company expects first-quarter revenue of $61.5 billion, plus or minus $1.5 billion, compared with analysts' average estimate of $57.02 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Adjusted profit is expected to be $38.15 per share in the first quarter, plus or minus $1, above estimates of $35.40.

As the only major US-based HBM chipmaker, Micron has seen orders far exceed capacity, while the AI memory boom has tightened conventional chip supplies and driven prices higher across the broader semiconductor market.
To meet demand, Micron is expanding aggressively and has lifted planned US investments to over $250 billion through 2035, as Amazon, Alphabet and other tech giants are set to spend more than $730 billion on AI infrastructure this year.
"Micron's complete blowout earnings and forecast should put the nail in the coffin of the ongoing doubters about the resiliency of the AI buildout," said Bob O'Donnell, chief analyst at TECHnalysis Research.
Fourth-quarter revenue more than quadrupled to $54.23 billion, beating estimates of $51.07 billion. Adjusted profit came in at $33.42 per share, exceeding estimates of $31.61.
